sentences.japanese: 家々の軒先には旗が掲げられていた。
sentences.english: The fronts of the houses were hung with flags.

sentences.japanese: 以下に掲げる人が合格です。
sentences.english: The following persons passed the examination.

sentences.japanese: 安全のために機械の前に掲示を掲げるつもりだ。
sentences.english: We will set up a notice in front of the machine for safety's sake.

sentences.japanese: その団体は騒音が有害なことを人々に思い起こされるためにポスターを掲げた。
sentences.english: The group put up posters to remind people that noise is harmful.

sentences.japanese: その船はアメリカ国旗を掲げていた。
sentences.english: The ship was flying the American flag.
